thread:
marta: Quick idea — propose a 'slow-start' rollout knob that ramps traffic by window and also trims non-critical features per tenant to reduce token/latency cost.
kevin: Explain 'trims'?
marta: e.g., disable secondary reranker and long-context embeddings for the first 1k requests in a slice, then re-enable. Keeps output quality for seed users but saves cost.
anya: Sounds risky for user-facing features. Need clear telemetry and per-tenant opt-outs. Add feature flag + explicit override.
kevin: Agree. Flag naming suggestion: rollout/slow_start/<feature>/<tier>. Also need TTL and auto-reinstate policy.
marta: Also plan shadow-probes to compare outputs vs full config — run 5% shadow traffic with full stack to compute delta. We already have shadow probing infra? @samir
samir: We have a lightweight probe runner in eng-ml but it isn't wired into runtime routing. I can allocate 1 engineer for 2 weeks to wire it up.
lisa: Proposed launch criteria: 1) semantic delta < 1% on our eval prompts, 2) p99 latency within SLO for the canary cohort, 3) zero customer-facing regressions for 24h in the 1st slice.
kevin: Telemetry must include per-tenant token count, substituted-feature rate, failure-rate, and quality-delta from shadow probes. Also expose metrics to console per-route.
marta: Fallback policy: if delta > threshold OR errors spike -> auto-revert flag for that tenant for 10m and notify oncall + product channel.
anya: We should add an audit log for manual overrides (who, why, TTL). Security review needed for private deployments.
lisa: Confirmed — must not change KMS usage; private customers need same rollback guarantees and audit trail.
product-bot: deploy-canary scheduled for 1743220200 by @samir
kevin: OK. Rollout pacing suggestion: 1% -> 5% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m observation windows.
marta: Also add 'feature slimming' presets per-model for slow windows: short prompt truncation, lower sampling temp, disable reranker. These are reversible config patches.
anya: Can we surface an impact estimate before each step? e.g., token delta and cost delta projected per-tenant.
samir: We'll add a small estimator in the dashboard; needs a mapping from feature flags to token-impact heuristics. 1w engineering.
kevin: Runbook ask: include rollback steps, how to force-enable full stack for a tenant, and how to query shadow probe diffs.
marta: I'll draft the short playbook and post in #product under 'slow-start playbook' by EOD Friday.
support: Noted — we'll prepare a customer notification template for beta tenants and a short FAQ for support reps.
samir: Timeline recap: infra changes 2w, feature flags 3d, shadow probes 1w. Target soft-launch in ~3 weeks.
kevin: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
marta: TL;DR: implement slow-start knob + feature-slim presets + shadow probes + telemetry + runbook. I'll create a PR with the spec and a sample flag schema.
kevin: Thanks — assign reviewers: @lisa, @anya, @samir.
support: We'll prep monitoring docs for onboarding.
anya: One more: include a kill-switch that globally disables slimming across all tenants if we see systemic drift.
lisa: Added to the runbook checklist.
kevin: Great. Next steps: marta drafts spec; samir kicks infra; support drafts comms. Meeting if needed next Tues.
